actions.description: Create original collections, SVG image, WAV audio and generated payloads on one job-owned account.
Run public Desktop media sync calls and retain successful public completion, request counts and cursor observations.
Exchange additions, replacements and deletions in both directions; verify every received byte hash.
After the mutation and 26-file checks, receive the final 1005 current files with a fresh SDK cursor.
